summary: @Cambridgeport90 post kinds uses archive and taxonomies ratchet than the native post types included in WordPress. If you use @pfefferle theme all native post types will have microformats. You would only need post kind plugin if you wanted more types
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@Cambridgeport90 post kinds uses archive and taxonomies ratchet than the native post types included in WordPress. If you use @pfefferle theme all native post types will have microformats.

You would only need post kind plugin if you wanted more types
